import numpy as np

def low_rank_approximation(W, rank):
    U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
    U_r = U[:, :rank]
    S_r = np.diag(S[:rank])
    V_r = Vt[:rank, :]
    W_approx = U_r @ S_r @ V_r
    A = U_r @ np.sqrt(S_r)
    B = np.sqrt(S_r) @ V_r
    error = np.mean((W - W_approx) ** 2)
    return A, B, error
